description: This Java interface, SnapshotAdapter, defines methods for transforming snapshots between domain model and database representations for persistence in an Akka-based system. It includes methods for converting to and from snapshot store formats, specifically for use with Akka Persistence, and is intended for implementation to optimize snapshot storage, e.g., BSON format for MongoDB.

methods.name: toSnapshotStore
methods.description: Converts a domain model snapshot into a database-specific format for persistence.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SnapshotOffer)
methods.description: Transforms a database snapshot offered by Akka into the domain model format, or returns null.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SelectedSnapshot)
methods.description: Transforms a selected snapshot from the database into the domain model format, or returns null.
